pr.body:
Replace the repeated hex-pair matcher with a single-character matcher followed by an even-length check. The accepted lowercase ASCII hex language, empty bytes, matcher/fromhex exception history, final canonical check, /1 wire bytes and all content identities remain unchanged. This PR also integrates the preceding W012 cost investigation and its preserved evidence.

Paired three-sample complete-path measurements show peak RSS medians down 88.59%–90.35% and elapsed medians down 14.66%–22.80%; readback peak falls from about 7 GiB to about 692 MiB. Complete wire sizes/hashes are unchanged, including the 136.5 MB readback. Residual serialization/reconstruction cost and small-stage increases remain disclosed.

Frozen-source validation: Python 3.10/3.12 each 1656 passed, typing54, build and two clean installation smokes. Dedicated premerge review: 111 formal regressions, 150728 finite candidates and evidence/package checks; zero remaining must-fix findings. PM has independently checked contracts and a full readback. Actual merged-version combination checks will be recorded before final acceptance. Original large wire/install trees are adopted by version-bound prior independent evidence where absent locally.

No new wire format, writer/reader/memo work or production/M1 completion claim. New /2 compatibility and identity decisions remain separate.
